title: The locked door
starting_code: # The key is on the floor.
hints: Walk up to the key first and use `pick_up`.
Walk to the door and use `open` to open it.
Once the door is open, walk right to go through it.
intro: This corridor leads to the archive, but the door is locked. Do you see the key on the floor? You will need it.
outro: Well done. You keep your eyes open, and that is a good trait in a wizard.
learned: Now you know how to open a door with its own method, and that a locked one needs its key first.
